Requirements: [Bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun) & [Git](https://github.com/git/git)

How to use: Run `start.sh` on a terminal

If you used SillyTavern before you may want to clean the browsing data on the default port (http://127.0.0.1:8000) and/or try on a anonymous tab

Many things were changed in a short period of time and many features are still untested. expect breakage with extensions that are not self contained, with special support added for [RPG Companion](https://github.com/SpicyMarinara/rpg-companion-sillytavern), while most themes _should_ work although may look funky.

This repo contains a backend overhaul over the original [SillyTavern](https://github.com/SillyTavern/SillyTavern) this would not be possible without their previous work and all credits go to the original contributors.
